name: Summit AZ - Context - Page Coverage Snapshot 2026-05-20
body:
> Research · Summit Az · 2026-05-20

# Summary
Service x city coverage snapshot generated 2026-05-20 from live WordPress over SSH, checked against Kim's matrix of 12 services x 10 cities (120 expected pages). Stored inside a Claude Code worktree folder.

# Key facts
- 120 of 120 city-service pages exist, including 5 water softener installation drafts created 2026-05-20 (IDs 5703 to 5707: Mesa, Phoenix, Queen Creek, Scottsdale, Tempe) cloned from Chandler (ID 4043) with a bidirectional city swap. Each kept one intentional Chandler back-link.
- 2 private pages: Water Leak Detection Scottsdale (ID 3995) and Water Heaters Queen Creek (ID 4691).
- Drain cleaning data issues: ID 2332 (Fountain Hills) had the slug `emergency-plumber-in-fountain-hills-az`; ID 3100 was a duplicate Phoenix drain cleaning page with the slug `sewer-line-repair-phoenix`.
- FAQ schema added 2026-05-20: the `summit-location-seo.php` mu-plugin emits FAQPage on 105 of 115 city-service pages by parsing the FAQ accordion; the 10 General Plumbing pages had no accordion. Cached in `_summit_faqs_cache`, invalidated on Elementor save.

# Suggested next steps (from the file)
Decide on the private pages, fix the drain cleaning slugs and duplicate, add FAQ accordions to the General Plumbing pages. The drafts in [Summit AZ - Drafts Folder Overview](lib:brain-summit-az-drafts-folder-overview) followed from this.
